description: A strange Late Iron Age site that produced a large number of pits, deep shafts, and a wide range of finds, including querns loom weights, spindle whorls, animal remains, a cremation burial of a young male. The RSRB compares the site to Keston Villa in Kent, and tentatively categorises it as a 'shrine'. Only evidence of structure apparently comes from wall plaster fragments. Uncertain when the site went out of use, but was still active in the 2nd CE.
